base.description: base branch the scan and the PR target

ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head (issue #196); empty = genesis segment

org_config.description: org baseline contract ref owner/repo[/path][@ref] — org floor per spec/org-policy.md

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch scripts/dep-update.js from — pin to the same ref as this workflow

action.description: open-pr | existing-pr | flagged | flagged-only | none | skipped | dry-run

flagged.description: updates flagged for human review (not landed)

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head for this scan (issue #196)

pr_number.description: consolidated dep-update PR number (empty when none opened)

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the per-run installation token used for all gh auth + pushes (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)
